sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the processing and logic control unit.

The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Mousa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of the station.

rows: A work order must be opened
The unit is out of service and in test mode
Disconnect the power supply to the processing unit when changing the power supplies or the fans
Remove the filters from the cabinet doors
Clean the cabinet cards with the blower
Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them afterwards
Check all the fans, including the power supply fans, and replace any faulty one
Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them as per the table
Visually inspect the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one
Check the signals in coordination with the various departments

Maintenance Procedures Information System

Document No.: PCU-001-r0a | Equipment: Bailey Network-90 processing and logic control unit, Italian
Issued to: Esna Power Station
Document status: Approved
Date of document approval: 29 January 2009 | Procedure: Annual maintenance (I1-Y1)
Date of next review: January 2014
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the annual maintenance of the processing and logic control unit.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Hassan Mousa Hassan, tested by Eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmed, approved by Eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din Ahmed, and approved by Eng. Youssef Mahmoud Ali, General Manager of the station.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be opened | 
The unit is out of service and in test mode | 
Disconnect the power supply to the processing unit when changing the power supplies or the fans | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Avometer | 
Blower | 
Procedure to be Carried Out
 |  |  | Remove the filters from the cabinet doors | 1
 |  |  | Clean the cabinet cards with the blower | 2
 |  |  | Clean and wash the filters, then dry them and refit them afterwards | 3
 |  |  | Check all the fans, including the power supply fans, and replace any faulty one | 4
 |  |  | Check the output voltages of the power supplies and adjust them as per the table | 5
 |  |  | Visually inspect the condition of the cards and replace any faulty one | 6
 |  |  | Check the signals in coordination with the various departments | 7
